plant.fitted_to: Boot9 four-hour trace; last chronological quarter held out
plant.notes: Approximate input/output fit, not isolated valve calibration. Random delay, dead time, pressure, noise and leakage are stress hypotheses. Pending plant gas continues after valve cutoff.

limits: Stress failures are retained. Simulation cannot guarantee unknown cylinder flow, mixing changes or a stuck valve. A notified cylinder change resets learning; an unannounced abrupt pressure change is only observable after gas reaches the sensor.

deployment.status: Experimental firmware uploaded with CO2 disabled at every boot. Enabled-loop simulation remains FAILED; not validated for automatic gas injection.
